Quick notes up front:
- We support customer-managed keys for both Redwood Private (VPC) and the on-prem bundle. KMS integrations include AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS, and we support HSM-backed key wrapping for on-prem installs.
- We offer an air-gapped installation path; the runtime can be configured with zero egress and an offline license + support channel.
- Build provenance evidence: we can provide signed artifacts, SBOM exports, and CI/CD pipeline logs (redacted where necessary) as part of the evidence pack.

Subject: Internal: Detailed clarifications for Acme questionnaire

Vanessa / team — adding technical clarifications to the questionnaire items Liam flagged. Below are the concise answers we should surface to the customer and the evidence types we can provide. I'll attach the completed controls matrix as well.

1) Key management and HSM
- Support model: customer-managed keys (CMK) for encryption-at-rest and runtime key wrapping. On cloud VPC, we use native KMS integrations; for on-prem we support integrating with customer HSMs via PKCS#11 or a KMIP bridge.
- Evidence: configuration guide, sample KMIP/PKCS#11 config, test keys, HSM integration steps, and screenshots from a lab run.

2) Air-gapped / zero-egress deployment
- Implementation: the on-prem bundle can be installed in an air-gapped network. The control plane (optional) can be run locally with offline license tokens. No outbound telemetry is required; any operational telemetry is configurable and can be disabled.
- Evidence: installation playbook (offline), manifest of outbound endpoints (none required), and test checklist demonstrating disabled telemetry.

3) Build provenance, SBOM, artifact signing
- We produce SBOMs for release artifacts (CycloneDX), GPG-signed release artifacts, and CI pipeline logs for reproducible builds. We can provide signed manifests and a sample SBOM for the runtime.
- Evidence: SBOM export, signed artifact tarball stub, CI pipeline run IDs (redacted), and a short writeup on our release signing process.

4) Vulnerability management and patching
- Runtimes: monthly CVE scanning with emergency patches for critical/high; report cadence matches the customer's SLAs. For on-prem, customers control patch scheduling; we provide patch bundles and advisories.
- Evidence: vulnerability scan report (sample), patch release notes, and a recommended patch cadence doc.

5) Audit logging and integrity
- Logs: request/response audit logs, admin audit trails, and integrity hashes for deployment artifacts. Logs can be shipped to customer SIEMs or retained locally per policy.
- Evidence: schema for logs, sample log exports, and instructions for integrating with Splunk/Datadog/S3.

Operational notes for the call: Dev, please prepare a short demo of the on-prem installer, KMIP integration, and the offline license activation flow. Also, prepare a short slide explaining options for air-gap operations and support entitlements.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_onprem_controls_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Hi Liam / Nina — appreciate the close read. Below are consolidated answers and the evidence we've attached. We're happy to run the technical deep-dive on Thursday 2026-11-19 15:00 PT — I've tentatively booked the slot and will send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Consolidated answers (short):
- Outbound telemetry / license checks: the on-prem/offline install requires an initial offline license activation; subsequent license refresh is optional and can be performed via an offline token rotation or an on-prem activation service. There are no automatic external callbacks by default; all telemetry and phone-home behaviors are configurable and off by default for air-gapped installs.
- Key rotation with HSM: supported. Customers can rotate keys via our Key Management API against the KMIP/PKCS#11 integration without full runtime redeploy. We will include example automation scripts.
- Evidence provided: redacted SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), penetration test executive summary (redacted PDF), controls matrix (spreadsheet), sample SBOM, signed artifact sample, install playbook (offline), and network diagram.

Proposed mutual action plan:
1) NDA (if needed) and exchange of signed evidence — this week
2) Technical deep-dive + on-prem installer demo (Nov 19, 15:00 PT) — Markus & Dev lead
3) Trial deployment in a customer VPC with zero-egress configuration — 2-week trial window
4) Evidence review and procurement negotiation — week after trial

Next steps: please confirm the deep-dive time or propose an alternative. We'll attach the SOC 2 summary and penetration test executive summary to the DocuSign-protected evidence bundle.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
